question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Addmission"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Admission"**. (प्रवेश)

 
 
• **Example:** He sought** admission** to the prestigious university.
 
 

 
• **"Admission"** means the act of accepting someone into an institution or organization. (प्रवेश)

 
 
• **Example:** She was excited about her **admission** into the medical school.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Matriculation** (मैट्रिकुलेशन): The process of enrolling in a college or university.

 
 
• **Example:** Matriculation at this university requires passing an entrance exam.
 
 
 
• **Prohibition** (निषेध): The action of forbidding something, especially by law.
 
 
• **Example:** The prohibition of smoking in public places is strictly enforced.
 
 
 
• **Humorous** (हास्यजनक): Causing laughter and amusement; comic.
 
 
• **Example:** His humorous stories always make us laugh.
